Register of Wills, Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania. Estate Docket, Vol. 9, page 214.

No. 2217. Estate of PATRICK FLYNN, late of the Borough of Pottsville, laborer, deceased.
Died the 14th day of May, A.D. 1882, intestate.
Letters of Administration granted the 22nd day of May, 1882, unto BRIDGET FLYNN, widow of said decedent.
Bond in the sum of $400, with Owen Brennan and James Dolan sureties.
Inventory and appraisement filed 30th June 1882: household goods and wearing apparel, $118.50.
Account of the administratrix confirmed absolutely 12th March 1883.

No. 2218. Estate of MARGARET FOLEY, late of Cass Township, widow, deceased.
Will proved the 1st day of June, A.D. 1882. Letters testamentary unto Daniel Foley, executor.
